description: Source code implementing the LOLWUT command for Redis, including functions for rendering ASCII art on a canvas, handling different Redis versions, and drawing geometric shapes like squares and lines.

methods.name: lolwut5Command
methods.description: Handles LOLWUT command for Redis version 5.

methods.name: lolwut6Command
methods.description: Handles LOLWUT command for Redis version 6.

methods.name: lolwutUnstableCommand
methods.description: Displays Redis version info for unstable versions.

methods.name: lolwutCommand
methods.description: Main command handler that delegates to version-specific functions and manages command arguments.

methods.name: lwCreateCanvas
methods.description: Creates a new drawing canvas with specified width, height, and background color.

methods.name: lwFreeCanvas
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a canvas.

methods.name: lwDrawPixel
methods.description: Sets a pixel on the canvas to a specified color.

methods.name: lwGetPixel
methods.description: Retrieves the color of a pixel on the canvas.

methods.name: lwDrawLine
methods.description: Draws a line between two points on the canvas using Bresenham's algorithm.

methods.name: lwDrawSquare
methods.description: Draws a rotated square centered at given coordinates with specified size and rotation angle.
